guidance.heading: Outlook for 2026
section: Net income attributable to common stockholders guidance has been revised to a range of $3.31 to $3.37 per diluted share from the previous range of $3.11 to $3.19. We also increased the guidance range of full year normalized FFO attributable to common stockholders to a range of $6.47 to $6.53 per diluted share from the previous range of $6.36 to $6.44. In preparing our guidance, we have updated or confirmed the following assumptions:
•Same Store NOI: We expect average blended SSNOI growth of 15.0% to 16.25%, which is comprised of the following components:

•Investments: Our earnings guidance includes only those acquisitions announced or closed to date. Furthermore, no transitions, restructures or capital activity beyond those announced to date are included.

•General and Administrative Expenses: We anticipate general and administrative expenses to be approximately $267 million to $272 million, inclusive of stock-based compensation expense of approximately $60 million.

•Dispositions: We expect pro rata disposition proceeds of $1.9 billion at a blended yield of 6.5% in the next twelve months. This includes approximately $1.5 billion of consideration from expected property sales, as well as $328 million of expected proceeds from loan repayments.
